items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He got fired. Mr. Young fired him in Tampa, Florida. That's where we left him, in Tampa.

ctx.x: the guy that originated Shadow... That was an act in those days -- Shadow. And they didn't take Dirty Red.
Now, you mentioned Dirty Red from the carnival show. Tell us a little bit about him. He was a blues singer, right?

A blues singer, yeah, and a dancer -- and a comedian; he told jokes and things. But he could sing the blues real good. He got fired. Mr. Young fired him in Tampa, Florida. That's where we left him, in Tampa.
